families.label: Bot
families.rationale: Its median is above the benign median while its interquartile range substantially overlaps the benign timing range, supporting moderate downward scaling.

families.label: DDoS
families.rationale: Its median and upper quartile are substantially above the corresponding benign timing values, supporting strong downward scaling.

families.label: DoS GoldenEye
families.rationale: Its central timing distribution is far above the benign median and upper quartile, supporting scaling near the permitted minimum.

families.label: DoS Hulk
families.rationale: Its quartiles and median are much higher than the benign central distribution, supporting the strongest permitted downward scaling.

families.label: DoS Slowhttptest
families.rationale: Its central timing values are concentrated well above the benign median and upper quartile, supporting strong downward scaling.

families.label: DoS slowloris
families.rationale: Its broad distribution has a very high median and upper quartile relative to benign timings, supporting strong but slightly wider downward scaling.

families.label: FTP-Patator
families.rationale: Its lower quartile is near the benign lower quartile but its median and upper quartile are much higher, supporting a wider downward interval.

families.label: Heartbleed
families.rationale: Its observed timings are consistently high relative to the benign central distribution, supporting strong downward scaling.

families.label: Infiltration
families.rationale: Its observed timing range is concentrated near the high end of the benign distribution, supporting scaling near the permitted minimum.

families.label: PortScan
families.rationale: Its central timing distribution is substantially below even the benign lower quartile, supporting the strongest permitted upward scaling.

families.label: SSH-Patator
families.rationale: Its central timing values are far above the benign median and upper quartile, supporting scaling near the permitted minimum.

families.label: Web Attack - Brute Force
families.rationale: Its interquartile timing range is well above the benign central distribution, supporting strong downward scaling.

families.label: Web Attack - SQL Injection
families.rationale: Its tightly clustered timing values are well above the benign median and upper quartile, supporting strong downward scaling.

families.label: Web Attack - XSS
families.rationale: Its central timing values are well above the benign median and upper quartile, supporting strong downward scaling.
